$comment: Counts measured by `npm run stats`. `npm run check` fails when a count rises above these numbers, so the only way to add a long file, a long function or an undocumented export is to lower nothing and explain why in review. Lower a number here as soon as the count drops.

notes.filesOver200Lines: Three locale dictionaries (bn, en, hi) are one object literal each, kept whole so the three stay comparable; scripts/live-smoke.mjs and scripts/stats.mjs are development tooling that never ships.
notes.functionsOver40Lines: Each one carries a `long-function:` line in the comment above it giving the reason it stays in one block.
notes.functionsOver40LinesWithoutReason: Zero: every long function states its reason, so a new one without one fails the gate.
notes.exportsWithoutJsDoc: Zero: every exported function and constant in src carries a doc block explaining its job and, where relevant, its units.
